title: Changed Areas rejects a cited directory or glob that covers diff paths; builders lose a correction round to it (3 lanes)
summary: validateRequired reads each Changed Areas bullet's backticked path literally and rejects any that is not an exact Build-diff path ('cited path X is not in the Build diff'). Builders keep citing their predicate package as a directory or glob: cycle 1765 cited go/acs/cycle1765 (wave 44), cycle 1768 cited go/acs/cycle1768/*_test.go (wave 45), and 1765 also cited a brace path {cycle1761,cycle1764}. Each costs a full builder re-dispatch through the correction ladder for a format miss, not a logic defect.
fix: A code-owned recovery rung (logic over format): expand a cited directory, glob or brace list against the Build diff; accept the entry when it covers at least one diff path (and credit each covered material path with that entry's explanation); reject only a citation that covers no diff path. Keep the exact-path rule for everything else.
acceptance: A Changed Areas entry citing go/acs/cycle1768/*_test.go (or the directory) passes when the diff holds files under it (red today)
A citation covering no diff path is still rejected with the same message
source: console, 2026-09-30 wave-45 build floor of cycle 1768 (and wave 44's 1765)
